title: Pick This Debt Strategy Today

beats.say: At 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years because of the Rule of 72.
beats.visual: A single heavy metal padlock resting on a dark wood table, cinematic lighting from the side, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: If you're drowning in payments, today you pick one method to kill it.
beats.visual: Two identical blank envelopes sitting side by side on a concrete desk, moody shadows, overhead macro shot.

beats.say: Step one. List every single debt you owe right now on a paper list.
beats.visual: A hand holding a black pen writing on clean white paper, out of focus background, soft lamp light.

beats.say: Step two. Choose your battlefield. You want the debt avalanche or the debt snowball.
beats.visual: A silver chess knight standing upright on a dark slate board, dramatic side lighting, narrow aperture.

beats.say: The avalanche targets your highest interest rate first to save maximum cash.
beats.visual: A close-up of a vintage brass desk calculator resting on a dark leather notebook, moody atmosphere.

beats.say: The snowball targets your smallest balance first to build quick psychological wins.
beats.visual: A neat stack of small metallic coins casting long shadows across a wooden surface, macro lens.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about staying motivated.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single warm bulb glowing at the far end, symmetrical framing, cinematic grain.

beats.say: Math says avalanche always wins. Human psychology says snowball works better.
beats.visual: A mechanical pocket watch ticking on a weathered oak surface, warm tungsten light, soft focus.

beats.say: Step three. Automate the minimums on everything else today.
beats.visual: A dark smartphone resting face down on a minimal concrete stand, clean aesthetic, edge lighting.

beats.say: Then funnel every extra dollar toward your chosen target account immediately.
beats.visual: A single copper coin sliding slowly across a dark glass tabletop, cinematic motion blur, low key.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you about beating
beats.visual: An old leatherbound journal closed tight on a dark desk, moody backlighting, dust motes in the air.

caption: Pick your strategy today and kill the interest before it kills your future. #debtfree #personalfinance #moneytips #debtfreejourney
description: Stop guessing how to pay off what you owe. Pick between the debt avalanche and the debt snowball today using this simple three-step action plan.
first_comment: Are you team avalanche (highest rate) or team snowball (smallest balance)?

facts.basis: Rule of 72: at 24% debt doubles every 3 years
